text: {"features":[{"name":"Relevant software delivery experience","description":"How strongly the letter evidences professional experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software at meaningful scope.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only narrow but relevant professional experience, typically around three years and a small number of launched services, with little sense of broad ownership."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows solid early-career production experience through a few years of work and several services or launches, but the scope remains modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows established production experience, typically around five years or repeated lifecycle involvement across multiple services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production scope through five to seven years and clear ownership of several services across testing, maintenance, and launch."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive and highly relevant software-delivery experience, combining many years with numerous launched or maintained services and mature end-to-end ownership."}]},{"name":"Go backend depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows substantive Go experience relevant to backend or infrastructure work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States Go is a principal or frequent language but supports that claim only with the introductory summary."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Links Go to general production service work but gives no real sense of backend or infrastructure responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful Go use in production systems and some relevance to backend work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives concrete examples of designing, operating, or constraining backend or infrastructure systems in Go."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go central to multiple backend or platform designs with clear architectural ownership and especially strong role fit."}]},{"name":"Python engineering depth","description":"How convincingly the letter shows substantive Python experience for services, automation, or tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or gives no usable evidence of Python work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python only as light scripting or general familiarity without production responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for automation, internal tooling, or services in professional work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production Python experience across services and automation that other engineers rely on."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents Python as a major engineering tool with production-grade depth, such as critical automation, extensible services, or explicitly disciplined implementation practices."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"How clearly the letter demonstrates experience designing or operating agentic systems with bounded autonomy.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of agentic systems experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers vaguely to automation or agents without explaining how agent behavior is structured or constrained."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic tooling at a basic level, usually by pairing agents with supporting services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly explains an agent architecture, including bounded autonomy, guardrails, auditability, or a deliberate split between agents and supporting systems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong ownership of safe agentic system design through concrete detail on how agents and backend infrastructure work together under explicit operational constraints."}]},{"name":"Applied AI production experience","description":"How strongly the letter shows hands-on use of AI systems in production with attention to reliability or evaluation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or light exposure without clear production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows hands-on work with model-backed or LLM-backed features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI work plus explicit attention to evaluation, reliability, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial applied AI maturity by pairing shipped AI features with clear hardening, evaluation, and trustworthiness practices."}]},{"name":"Security assessment experience","description":"How much the letter demonstrates direct experience assessing designs or code for security issues and following through on remediation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of security assessment work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security only in broad terms or implies limited review activity without clear assessment practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows direct experience performing security reviews, threat modeling, or vulnerability-oriented code review."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows structured assessment work across new and existing systems, with findings documented or fixes followed through."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong hands-on assessment maturity by describing repeated formal reviews with an attacker's perspective and explicit remediation verification."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability handling automation","description":"How much the letter shows experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, classification, or routing.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of automating vulnerability intake or triage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions vulnerability-related work only broadly, without concrete automation responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building automation that classifies, routes, or otherwise reduces manual vulnerability-handling work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear ownership of a vulnerability triage pipeline, with details such as deduplication, prioritization, routing, or self-serve workflows."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents vulnerability-response automation as a major achievement, showing a manual queue transformed into a well-designed system that materially returned expert capacity."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic fluency","description":"How well the letter evidences practical algorithmic thinking through concrete use of data structures or algorithms in real systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of algorithmic or data-structure skill."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims comfort with algorithms or data structures without showing a real application."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of improving a system through better algorithm or data-structure choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical fluency through a substantial redesign of a high-throughput, scheduling, matching, correlation, or similar hard problem."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes algorithmic thinking a standout strength through an especially sophisticated example or framing that clearly turns a hard problem into a tractable system."}]},{"name":"Security-at-scale mandate understanding","description":"How well the letter shows understanding that this role uses tooling and automation to scale security work across a large engineering organization.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats the role as a generic software or security job without showing how it scales security work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Notes broad security impact or large scale but does not explain the mechanism of leverage."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Connects the role to automation, internal tooling, or development-lifecycle support in a generally accurate way."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear understanding of the team's leverage by discussing reduced manual workload, secure defaults, or the compounding impact of central tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates nuanced grasp of the mandate by articulating ideas such as scaling scarce expert judgment, variant analysis, or turning one finding into organization-wide protection."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"How strongly the letter frames security engineering as helping other engineers work safely and efficiently through low-friction tooling and defaults.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no meaningful signal of designing for developer users or reducing friction in their workflow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Briefly mentions helping teams without showing how security tooling should fit into their day-to-day work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows clear interest in helping engineers through tooling or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frames security as making the secure path easy, routine, or low-friction for busy developers."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes developer enablement a core philosophy by emphasizing workflow fit, defaults over documents, and tools that quietly multiply other engineers' effectiveness."}]},{"name":"Role-specific motivation","description":"How specifically and credibly the letter explains why this Google Information Security Engineering role is the applicant's next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives a generic application statement with little explanation of why this role or team is appealing."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in the role but in broadly interchangeable terms that could fit many security-engineering jobs."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a plausible role-specific reason, such as interest in foundational security tooling or Google-scale impact."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Links the role clearly to prior work and future direction, making the move feel logically motivated."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes the motivation especially credible and specific by tying personal engineering values, past experience, and the exact team mandate into one coherent reason for applying."}]},{"name":"Evidence strength","description":"How concrete, specific, and outcome-oriented the letter's supporting examples are.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims about skills or fit with little concrete supporting detail."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some examples, but they remain vague, generic, or missing clear outcomes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports most major claims with concrete examples of work or projects."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frequently pairs skills with specific systems, responsibilities, or visible outcomes such as reduced workload or improved performance."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds a highly convincing case through crisp, concrete examples that show both what was done and why it mattered."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"How free the letter is from typos, grammatical errors, and other distracting mechanical problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent mistakes that repeatedly distract from the content or make the writing feel careless."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several noticeable errors that interrupt reading but do not fully obscure meaning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Has a few errors or awkward spots, yet remains generally readable and professional."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is clean and professional with only rare minor slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and polished throughout."}]},{"name":"Narrative effectiveness","description":"How engaging, coherent, and memorable the letter is as a piece of persuasive writing.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as flat, fragmented, or formulaic enough that the application leaves little impression."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a workable structure but limited voice or momentum, making it only mildly persuasive."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is clear and coherent, with some purposeful framing or flow beyond a bare list of qualifications."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses a strong opening, logical progression, and distinctive voice to make the case easy to follow and remember."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers an especially compelling narrative that turns qualifications into a vivid, persuasive story of fit."}]},{"name":"Open-source engagement","description":"How strongly the letter shows contribution to or stewardship of open-source software.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no open-source evidence."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional or light open-source contributions without ongoing responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular patching or corrective contributions to tools used at work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows sustained ownership, such as maintaining a project or handling recurring review and release work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial open-source stewardship with an active user or contributor community and clear responsibility for direction, review, and releases."}]},{"name":"Personal technical initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows self-directed technical building outside assigned professional work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of side projects or self-directed building."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small personal project or tinkering habit without much scope or technical challenge."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a sustained side project that demonstrates continued curiosity or skill practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a technically ambitious self-directed build, such as a distributed or systems-heavy project undertaken to learn hard problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents unusually strong personal initiative through substantial, technically challenging projects chosen specifically to tackle difficult engineering edge cases or deepen expertise."}]},{"name":"Independent security skill development","description":"How strongly the letter shows proactive security learning beyond normal job duties through certifications or attacker-oriented practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of security skill-building outside day-to-day work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows modest extra effort, such as an entry-level security certification or occasional security practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful ongoing development through recurring CTF participation or a deliberate certification choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong independent development through serious attacker-oriented practice or a demanding hands-on credential."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-driven security development by combining a rigorous practical credential with sustained high-level offensive practice, or an equivalently strong pattern of outside security mastery."}]}]}
